topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes, connects them to prior practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the discovery of viral and cellular oncogenes and detail the experimental assays used to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions, regulatory pathways, and genetic mechanisms that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation produce genomic instability and cellular stress in cancer.

topics.label: Multistep Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the sequential accumulation of inherited and somatic mutations drives tumor development and clonal evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, suggests further reading, and previews the next lecture.
